authority_rule: Consume the evaluator-owned task-specific event exactly once and revise only its affected closure.

event_contract.after_state: A synchronization specialist supplies operation IDs, base revisions, acknowledgments, broadcasts, and deterministic conflict handling after provisional realtime handlers exist.
event_contract.before_state: Task-specific provisional work exists before synchronization_contract_delivered.

forbidden_shortcut: Do not ignore the event, retain a superseded state, over-invalidate preserved work, or claim closure without re-verification.
